verdict.rationale: Ashby ships AI features (Assistant, AI Notetaker, AI candidate rediscovery), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, contractual commitment, or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The only related item is a community report of a candidate-side opt-out form for AI resume processing that reportedly never worked. That item concerns processing rather than training and is not a vendor claim, so it cannot support a full, partial or disputed verdict.
